OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Chinese Growth Center drives growth across Chinese-speaking markets. This role sits close to the center of decision-making, supporting the Head of CGC directly on high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

The immediate focus is the practical application of AI in business operations — identifying where AI can drive real productivity gains, and making it actually happen. Beyond the AI workstream, this role will evolve to cover other strategic initiatives over time.

This is a role for someone who takes ownership end-to-end. You will be expected to get your hands dirty, move fast, and deliver — not just coordinate.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Drive the full lifecycle of AI initiatives hands-on — from scoping and tool research to solution design, testing, and rollout
• Work across teams to embed AI tools into real business workflows and track measurable outcomes
• Identify blockers early and solve them proactively, without waiting to be directed
• Stay current on emerging AI tools and synthesize findings into repeatable best practices for the team
• Own progress tracking and delivery management for key initiatives, keeping milestones on track and quality high
• Build lightweight dashboards and reporting to keep the Head of CGC informed and decisions moving
• Pick up new initiatives quickly, build context fast, and deliver in ambiguous or fast-changing situations
• Surface collaboration friction across teams and drive alignment where needed

What We Look For In You

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Deep AI User, with practical experience using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Midjourney) — able to speak to specific use cases and outcomes
• Strong ownership and hands-on ability to work steadily under pressure, managing multiple workstreams in parallel and still deliver quality
• Clear communicator who is able to collaborate and convey work process well to various stakeholders
• Proficiency in English as a working language, and fluent in Mandarin in order to service Mandarin-speaking clients (as required in the role)

Nice to Haves

• Experience in internet, content, e-commerce, or growth-related roles
• Background in cross-functional project management or initiative delivery
• Hands-on with Prompt Engineering or workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n)
• Familiarity with Chinese-speaking market dynamics and user behavior

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package
• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
